subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw-even-g2-node` with signed `platform: even-hub` and `deviceFamily: glasses` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap identity that receives the bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The code path is narrow and tested, but it expands who can skip owner approval during setup-code bootstrap and commits a stable Gateway client id for an external hardware integration, which automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve current narrow identity
options.body: Accept this minimal Gateway/protocol slice as the supported bootstrap identity while leaving app placement and command policy to the linked feature issue.

options.title: Rename before merge
options.body: Choose a generation-neutral Even Hub client id and have the contributor update this PR plus the external app before merge.

options.title: Defer the identity decision
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers settle the broader Even Hub ownership and metadata direction in the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Approve current narrow identity
recommendation.body: Accept this minimal Gateway/protocol slice as the supported bootstrap identity while leaving app placement and command policy to the linked feature issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent bootstrap/auth history and is the best individual routing candidate alongside secops review.
